items.title: 2.4 Harkat ki equations (equations of motion) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.4 with Figs. 2.5 to 2.7 and Examples 2.2 to 2.4 (PDF 28-33).

blocks.text: Equations of motion kisi cheez ki harkat ko us ke teen kinematic variables se bayan karti hain: velocity (v), position (s) aur time (t). In variables ko jorne ke teen tareeqe hain, velocity-time, position-time aur velocity-position, jo isi tarteeb se pehli, doosri aur teesri equation of motion kehlati hain. Yeh equations sirf un cheezon par lagu hoti hain jo seedhi lakeer mein mustaqil acceleration se chal rahi hon.
Pehli equation of motion ki derivation

Farz karein ek jism seedhi lakeer mein yaksan acceleration a se ibtidai velocity vi ke saath chalta hai, aur us ki velocity waqt t mein vi se aakhri qeemat vf ho jati hai. Is wuqfe mein paida acceleration a = (vf - vi)/t hai. Tarteeb badal kar vf - vi = at, ya vf = vi + at ... (2.11). Yeh pehli equation of motion hai: yeh mustaqil acceleration a se chalte jism ki hasil shuda aakhri velocity ko us ki ibtidai velocity aur waqt t se jorti hai.
Graphical tareeqe se pehli equation ki derivation

Farz karein nuqte A par jism ki velocity vi hai, jo waqt t mein nuqte B par vf ho jati hai (Fig. 2.5). B se x-axis par amood BD aur B se y-axis par amood BE kheencha jata hai, taake OA = vi (ibtidai velocity) aur BD = vf (aakhri velocity). Graph se BD = BC + CD = BC + OA (chunke OA = CD); is liye vf = BC + vi ... (2.12). BC ki qeemat lakeer AB ke slope se milti hai, jo acceleration a ke barabar hai: a = BC/AC, aur chunke AC = t, a = BC/t, ya BC = at ... (2.13). (2.12) aur (2.13) mila kar vf = at + vi, ya vf = vi + at.

blocks.alt: Velocity-time graph. Seedhi lakeer AB velocity axis ke nuqte A (OA = vi) se B (BD = vf) tak charhti hai. Nuqta-daar lakeerein E se B, A se C (lambai t) aur B se C ke raste time axis par D tak; BD ke saath dohra teer vf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.5: Velocity-time graph (kitab ki Figure 2.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Doosri equation of motion ki derivation

Farz karein seedhi lakeer mein yaksan acceleration a se chalte jism ki ibtidai velocity vi hai, jo waqt t ke baad vf ho jati hai, aur yeh waqt t mein kisi khaas simt mein faasla S tay karta hai. Velocity ki tareef displacement ki tabdeeli ki raftar se, velocity = displacement / time, ya displacement = velocity x time. Agar velocity mustaqil na ho to hum ausat velocity istemal karte hain: displacement = ausat velocity x time = ((aakhri velocity + ibtidai velocity)/2) x time, to S = ((vi + vf)/2) t. Pehli equation se S = ((vi + vi + at)/2) t = ((2 vi + at)/2) t, to 2S = 2 vi t + a t^2, ya S = vi t + (1/2) a t^2 ... (2.14). Yeh doosri equation of motion hai.
Graphical tareeqe se doosri equation ki derivation

Ibtidai velocity vi wale jism ke velocity-time graph par, jo mustaqil acceleration a se chalte hue waqt t mein vf hasil karta aur displacement S tay karta hai (Fig. 2.6), tay kiya faasla S = v x t hai, jo shakal OABD ka raqba hai: S = (mustateel OACD ka raqba) + (triangle ABC ka raqba) = (OA x OD) + (1/2)(AC x BC). Chunke OA = vi aur OD = AC = t, S = vi x t + (1/2)(t x BC); aur pehli equation se BC = at, to S = vi t + (1/2)(t x at), ya S = vi t + (1/2) a t^2.

blocks.alt: Velocity-time graph. Seedhi lakeer AB velocity axis ke nuqte A (OA = vi) se B (BD = vf) tak charhti hai. Nuqta-daar lakeerein E se B, A se C (lambai t) aur B se C ke raste time axis par D tak; BD ke saath dohra teer vf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: Velocity-time graph (kitab ki Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ke neeche ka raqba (area) OABD tay kiya gaya faasla S hai. Ise do hisson mein dekhein: neeche mustateel (rectangle) OACD, jis ka raqba OA x OD = vi x t hai, aur us ke oopar tikon (triangle) ABC, jis ka raqba (1/2) x AC x BC = (1/2) x t x at hai. Dono jama karne se S = vi t + (1/2) a t^2 milta hai.
Teesri equation of motion ki derivation

Seedhi lakeer mein ibtidai velocity vi se chalta jism lein jo waqt t mein aakhri qeemat vf hasil karta hai, is wuqfe mein displacement S ke saath. Phir displacement = ((ibtidai velocity + aakhri velocity)/2) x time, S = ((vi + vf)/2) t, ya 2S = (vi + vf) t ... (2.15). Pehli equation se vf = vi + at, to t = (vf - vi)/a. t ki yeh qeemat (2.15) mein rakhte hue 2S = (vi + vf)((vf - vi)/a), ya 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2. Yeh teesri equation of motion hai.
Graphical tareeqe se teesri equation ki derivation

Speed-time graph (Fig. 2.7) mein jism ka tay kiya kul faasla S graph ke neeche raqba OABD hai, ek trapezium: S = (1/2)(mutawazi kinaron ka majmooa) x oonchai = (1/2)(OA + BD) x OD. Chunke OA = vi, BD = vf aur OD = t, S = (1/2)(vi + vf) x t. Pehli equation se t = (vf - vi)/a; t rakhte hue S = (1/2)(vi + vf)((vf - vi)/a), ya 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2 ... (2.16).

blocks.alt: Velocity-time graph. Seedhi lakeer AB velocity axis ke nuqte A (OA = vi) se B (BD = vf) tak charhti hai. Nuqta-daar lakeerein E se B, A se C (lambai t) aur B se C ke raste time axis par D tak; BD ke saath dohra teer vf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.7: Velocity-time graph (kitab ki Figure 2.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Equations of motion yaksan acceleration wali seedhi harkat ke masail ke liye mufeed hain, jab koi cheez seedhi lakeer mein chalti hai. Agar us ki harkat ki simt na badle to sab vector quantities scalars ki tarah sambhali ja sakti hain: ibtidai velocity musbat li jati hai aur jin miqdaron ki simt ibtidai velocity ke ulat ho unhen manfi nishan diya jata hai. Hawa ki rukawat na ho to Zameen ki satah par free fall mein sab cheezein yaksan acceleration se Zameen ki taraf chalti hain, jo acceleration due to gravity kehlata hai, g se zahir hota hai, aur Zameen ki satah par jis ki ausat qeemat 9.8 m s^-2 neeche ki simt mein li jati hai. Yaksan taur par tez hoti harkat ki equations a ki jagah g rakh kar free-fall harkat par bhi lagu hoti hain.
Hal shuda misalein

blocks.title: Example 2.2
blocks.text: 10 m s^-1 se chalti car 2 m s^-2 se yaksan taur par tez hoti hai. 5 s baad us ki velocity nikalein. Hal: vi = 10 m s^-1, a = 2 m s^-2, t = 5 s. Pehli equation se vf = vi + at = 10 m s^-1 + 2 m s^-2 x 5 s = 10 m s^-1 + 10 m s^-1 = 20 m s^-1.

blocks.title: Example 2.3
blocks.text: Car ibtidai velocity 15 m s^-1 se chalti hai aur 4 seconds tak 2 m s^-2 se tez hoti hai. Us ka displacement nikalein. Hal: vi = 15 m s^-1, a = 2 m s^-2, t = 4 s. Doosri equation se S = vi t + (1/2) a t^2 = (15 m s^-1 x 4 s) + (1/2)(2 m s^-2)(16 s^2) = 76 m.

blocks.title: Example 2.4
blocks.text: Chhote faasle ki race mein car sukoon se chal kar mustaqil acceleration se 0.45 km tay karne ke baad 300 km h^-1 tak pohnchti hai. Acceleration nikalein. Hal: vi = 0; vf = 300 km h^-1 = (300 x 1000)/(60 x 60) m s^-1 = 250/3 m s^-1; S = 0.45 km = 450 m. Teesri equation vf^2 - vi^2 = 2aS se: (250/3 m s^-1)^2 - 0 = 2 x a x 450 m, to a = 6944.4 m^2 s^-2 / 900 m = 7.72 m s^-2.

blocks.caption: Teen equations of motion
rows: BD = BC + OA; AB ka slope = a
trapezium OABD ka raqba, t = (vf - vi)/a ke saath

blocks.prompt: Ek train 600 m mein 30 m s^-1 se yaksan taur par ruk jati hai. Us ki deceleration aur liya gaya waqt nikalein; har ek kaun si equation deti hai, aur acceleration manfi kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Teesri equation: 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2 se a = (0 - 900)/(2 x 600) = -0.75 m s^-2; pehli equation: t = (vf - vi)/a = (0 - 30)/(-0.75) = 40 s. Ibtidai velocity musbat li jati hai, aur acceleration us ke ulat hai kyunke train sust ho rahi hai, is liye manfi nishan.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Mustaqil a se seedhi harkat: vf = vi + at; S = vi t + (1/2) a t^2; 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2. Graph se: v-t lakeer ka slope = a, neeche raqba = S (mustateel + triangle, ya trapezium).
Ibtidai velocity musbat, ulti miqdarein manfi; free fall: a = g = 9.8 m s^-2 neeche. Misalein: 20 m s^-1; 76 m; 7.72 m s^-2.
